annotations.title: Latest COT positions for one market

description: The latest COT report for one market: long, short and net positions of every trader group, the week-on-week change, % of open interest. Without an account and with a free account: the Legacy report. COT Premium and Data API keys: every report family (Legacy, Disaggregated, TFF, Supplemental); COT Premium also adds the close price. Both CFTC variants (Futures Only and Futures & Options Combined) with COT Premium and Data API keys; without an account and with a free account, each report's default variant.

market.description: A CFTC code (e.g. 099741), a ticker (e.g. 6E, GC) or a market name.

report.description: Report family: legacy (default), disaggregated, tff or supplemental.

variant.description: CFTC variant: futonly = Futures Only, combined = Futures & Options Combined. Default: the report's own (Legacy: futonly; Disaggregated, TFF: combined; Supplemental is published combined only).

name: get_latest_positions
